def _features(train, test):
    (x, refs, lab, stratum) = (np.concatenate((train[k], test[k]), axis=0) for k in ('coupon_features_raw', 'ref_coupons', 'lab_id', 'stratum'))
    for label in np.unique(lab):
        mask = lab == label
        panel = refs[mask]
        center = np.median(np.mean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.std(panel, axis=0))
        x[mask] = (x[mask] - center) / scale
    (_, cell, counts) = np.unique(np.column_stack((lab, stratum)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    weights = 1.0 / counts[cell]
    for col in x.T:
        known = np.isfinite(col)
        col[~known] = np.average(col[known], weights=weights[known])
    return (x[:len(train['lab_id'])], x[len(train['lab_id']):])

def _loads(split, bridge):
    return tuple((split[k] @ bridge[1:] + bridge[0] for k in ('past_channel_raw', 'hold_channel_raw')))

def solve_batch(dataset):
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (dt, t) = (dataset['past_dt'], dataset['eval_times'])
    bridge = _bridge(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    (x_train, x_test) = _features(train, test)
    (taus, theta) = _material(train, bridge, x_train, dt, t)
    (curve, rate) = _basis(taus, *_loads(test, bridge), x_test, dt, t)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + curve @ theta, 'initial_rate_pred': rate @ theta}
